meta.question: Do the University of Akron and Case Western Reserve collaborate, and on polymer work specifically?
meta.sources: OpenAlex works listing both institutions; NSF awards API, awards to either institution since 2012.
meta.row: one year: works listing both institutions, works matching ‘polymer’, and each institution’s own total output.
meta.two_measures: Publications and federal awards are independent instruments aimed at the same proposition, which is what makes this triangulation rather than juxtaposition. They can disagree.
meta.polymer_bound: Polymer relevance is OpenAlex subfield 2507, ‘Polymers and Plastics’, a classification rather than a keyword. Biomaterials is a separate subfield (2502) and is counted beside it, never merged into it. The unbounded coauthorship count is published alongside both.
meta.what_a_null_would_mean: This instrument can demonstrate collaboration and CANNOT demonstrate its absence. OpenAlex affiliation coverage is incomplete, NSF’s co-PI field lists signatories rather than the coalition, and neither sees industry contracts, consortium membership, joint teaching or a conversation. A low count means not detectable at this resolution.
meta.control: Each university’s own annual output is carried beside the joint count, because a joint series alone cannot tell a thinning relationship from an indexing lag or from one partner shrinking.
